g.text: never lives in the repo — it is
imported at runtime from a locally generated
plan.json. Import matches items by (type, title)
and updates in place, so a plan item's id survives
a re-import and focus_sessions keep pointing at it.
role : varchar(16) (OWNER | PARTNER; one OWNER, partial unique index)
created_at : timestamptz (rotation is scheduled off this)
year_num : int CHECK 1-5 · qtr : int CHECK 1-20
